subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers keep this issue as the canonical reaction-specific live-diagnostics target, or fold it into a broader Slack Socket Mode investigation before any code change?
rationale: The code already has handler-level reaction support, but the remaining failure is a live delivery/drop-boundary question that requires Slack workspace evidence or maintainer-owned diagnosis rather than a speculative automated fix.

options.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Diagnostic Target
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes and gateway trace logs that identify the first failing boundary.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Socket Mode Issue
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89222 as canonical only if its missing report is added and proves the same reaction failure family.

options.title: Route To Liveness Investigation
options.body: Tie this to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77249 only if live proof shows Slack Socket Mode is wedged rather than delivering other event types normally.

recommendation.title: Keep Reaction-Specific Diagnostic Target
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer or reporter captures redacted current-main Socket Mode reaction envelopes and gateway trace logs that identify the first failing boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The Slack monitor history and mismatch-filter ownership make this the strongest available routing candidate for deciding the diagnostic boundary.
